prompt: LLVM constrained frem rounding mode argument effect
answer:
For `llvm.experimental.constrained.frem`, the rounding-mode argument has **no effect on the computed remainder**: when `frem` produces a meaningful result, it is always exact, so rounding is not needed.

The argument was retained primarily for implementation uniformity with other constrained intrinsics. The constrained intrinsic is still needed to preserve exceptional behavior, such as `frem inf, x` and `frem x, 0`.

Sources: [D27028](https://reviews.llvm.org/D27028), [LLVM commit discussion](https://lists.llvm.org/pipermail/llvm-commits/Week-of-Mon-20180305/531396.html)
